en.label: Talk at Campus Vaihingen
en.question: Will I soon be replaced?
en.title: AI, my future and the Bible
en.subtitle: What makes humans unique – and what future does God have for them?
paragraphs: AI solves complex maths problems, develops software and designs technical components. Increasingly, it can complete in seconds tasks that we spend years learning to do. Will we soon become redundant? Does a bleak future await us?
The Bible presents a very different perspective: God created human beings in His image and gave them a calling that no machine can fulfil.
What does the Bible say about AI, and what does that mean for your future? Come along and find out.
